mutants.name: global-editor-permission
mutants.rationale: An editor role is incorrectly treated as global instead of scoped to the owning team. Existing denial examples lack an editor role elsewhere.

replacements.after:
site =
      if Plausible.Repo.get_by(Plausible.Teams.Membership,
           user_id: socket.assigns.current_user.id, role: :editor) do
        Plausible.Repo.get_by!(Plausible.Site, domain: domain)
      else
        Plausible.Sites.get_for_user!(socket.assigns.current_user, domain,
          roles: [:editor, :owner, :admin, :super_admin])
      end
